text:
# Pre-market brief, Fri 2026-11-06 (~8:50 AM ET)

1. **Hot October jobs (OUT 8:30):** NFP +165k vs Dow Jones ~59k; UE 4.1% (vs 4.2% est.); Aug/Sep revised up +84k combined; AHE +0.4% m/m / +3.1% y/y (vs 0.3% / 2.9%). Firm labor → December hike odds stay elevated ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/06/jobs-report-october-2026.html); [BLS sched](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/empsit.htm)).
2. **Futures mixed into the print (pre-8:30):** NQ e-minis ~+1.2–1.4%, ES ~+0.3%, YM ~−0.9% as chips bounced off Thu’s rout ([Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nasdaq-futures-rise-after-steep-ai-selloff-as-chip-stocks-stabilize-5007026); [Investing movers](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-airbnb-cloudflare-iren-rally-atlassian-five9-tumble-5007530)).
3. **Asia AI rout overnight:** Nikkei entered bear (~−7% wk); Kospi/TAIEX also hard hit on data-center/AI spend fears after Dem sweep ([X](https://x.com/i/trending/2117872223541190791); [X](https://x.com/i/trending/2118672352833933813)). AI-hardware group stays in avoid through 11/10 despite pre bounce (MU/AMD/NVDA/SMH +~5–9%).
4. **Gap winners — skip open (>5% rule):** ABNB ~+11–13% (Q3 beat, FY rev growth to high teens, $12B buyback); MRNA ~+8.5–10% (EPS $0.38 vs −$1.25 est., rev $1.31B, FY growth raised to 15–25%); NET ~+13–19%; IREN ~+18% (still group-avoid) ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-airbnb-cloudflare-iren-rally-atlassian-five9-tumble-5007530); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/06/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-moderna-airbnb-cloudflare-affirm-more.html); [Airbnb](https://news.airbnb.com/airbnb-q3-2026-financial-results)).
5. **Gap losers:** TEAM −16 to −18% (soft FY27 growth); FIVN ~−17% (soft Q4 EPS); DKNG ~−20%+ miss; AXON ~−9% miss/weak guide ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/06/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-premarket-moderna-airbnb-cloudflare-affirm-more.html)).
6. **Oil/BTC/rates:** Brent ~$100 / WTI ~$92 (rebound; energy avoid dropped); BTC ~$75.7–76k; gold ~$4,050; 10-yr ~4.83–4.84% ([Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/en-ch/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---ai-chip-rout-spreads-from-wall-street-to-asia---6-november-2026-06112026); [Ausprime](https://ausprime.eu/2026/11/06/market-update-232/)).
7. **Still today:** UMich prelim sentiment 10:00. Next week: CPI Tue 11/10 8:30 ([BLS](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2026/11_sched_list.htm)).

## Swing ideas
- **HUM** long, med. Adj LPS $0.70 beat ~−$1.00 est.; raised FY adj EPS to ≥$9.50 from ≥$9.00; rev $41.16B; pre ~flat to +3.7% (under 5% gap rule) ([Humana](https://humana.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/humana-reports-third-quarter-2026-financial-results-raises-full); [ainvest](https://www.ainvest.com/news/wire/item/humana-shares-rise-3-7-premarket-raises-annual-profit-forecast-2611/)). Risk: Star Ratings headwind; MA medical-cost / Dem policy.
- **Skip open (not new calls):** ABNB, MRNA — both >5% gaps; prefer log at close if still green.
